answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted reputation that grows only through a long voyage of verified work: each agent starts with a small trust allowance in a shared lagoon of tasks, and only after completing many attested jobs without fraud does its weight rise toward the zenith of full voting power. Creating a new fake identity restarts that slow climb from zero, so an attacker must pay the full time and compute cost for every Sybil, while honest agents keep the reputation they earned.
